pack.title: Glimpse Alpha V2.4.8
pack.summary: Release V2.4.8. 6 change(s) in this update - see the full changelog on the Wiki for details.

launcher.notes: The launcher is now called Corvus, and has the Aurora Corvus logo as its app icon. Your existing settings — pack folder, automatic update preference, backup retention — are carried over the first time you run it, and the old settings folder is left in place untouched as a safety net, so nothing is lost either way. Please note that because the app's name changed, installing this version does NOT replace the old one: a new Corvus app appears alongside the existing Glimpse Launcher, which you can delete by hand once you have confirmed Corvus opens with your settings intact. The download filenames change from glimpse-launcher-* to corvus-* for the same reason. Nothing about how updating, Play, or Settings work has changed.
